rationale.text: An untitled iframe is hidden from assistive technologies with aria-hidden="true". The glossary says some frames serve only technical operations and may be made unavailable to assistive technologies with aria-hidden="true", in which case criterion 2.1 does not apply; whether this frame is such a technical frame, and whether hiding it does not hinder it, needs judgment. The custom check answers cannot_tell (step 3); only the record supports this branch. axe's frame-title does not examine this aria-hidden frame and reports no fault, so the reason at full is cannot_tell; at fail_only, needs_review, not_enabled.

citations.quote: Certains cadres servent uniquement à des opérations techniques

Si cela ne gêne pas le fonctionnement de ce type de cadre, il est possible de les rendre indisponibles aux technologies d’assistance en utilisant l’attribut WAI-ARIA aria-hidden="true". Dans ce cas le critère 2.1 et le critère 2.2 seront non applicables.
